meta.name: Criminal Justice A Family Matter
meta.description:
Attorney Madhav Mishra represents Raj Nagpal, discovered with murdered nurse Roshni Saluja after his child's party. As the trial unfolds, hidden facts emerge, questioning identities.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: A Birthday to Remember
videos.overview: Dr Raj Nagpal is found holding a bloodied body after his daughter's birthday. Officer Gauri Karmarkar expects a simple case, but an unexpected player asks Madhav Mishra for help.

videos.title: Buried Secrets
videos.overview: Raj is denied bail for Roshni Saluja's murder. Madhav grows suspicious after meeting Anju and Ira. Gauri intensifies her hunt for the murder weapon.

videos.title: Quid Pro Quo
videos.overview: As Raj stays in custody, Madhav's team digs deeper, uncovering new suspects. Meanwhile, Gauri intensifies her hunt for the weapon, but complications arise.

videos.title: Domino Effect
videos.overview: While Madhav uncovers a new lead at Roshni's funeral, Gauri uncovers secrets about Roshni. Lekha Agastya takes over as the prosecutor, and Anju takes matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Trauma Flashback
videos.overview: Kamala's memories reveal a new clue, giving Lekha the upper hand. As husband and wife face off in court, Madhav scrambles to defend Raj with mounting evidence against him.

videos.title: Sins of the Privileged
videos.overview: With 2 days to prepare, Madhav faces Kamala on the stand. Lekha changes tactics with a surprise witness. Her closing argument casts doubt on the Nagpal family, pushing Madhav to the edge.

videos.title: The Missing Link
videos.overview: As Raj's defence begins, Madhav calls a new witness. Meanwhile, Ratna and Deep uncover crucial evidence, rushing to court and shifting the trial's dynamics dramatically.

videos.title: The Higher Law
videos.overview: As the trial nears its end, Anju's testimony unveils new secrets. A closed-chamber meeting calls an unexpected witness, and Madhav senses the case is far from over.
